ui.chat.sidebar.agents.list_join.role: agent-name list joiner inside the built-in agent installation offer sentence
ui.chat.sidebar.agents.list_join.tone: terse, neutral Simplified Chinese enumeration; no sentence-final punctuation
ui.chat.sidebar.agents.list_join.length: Variable width from agent names; each join adds one Chinese character (two display cells), with no added spaces or fixed width limit.
ui.chat.sidebar.agents.list_join.note: Use 和 without a preceding comma for a pair and before the final item; use 、 between middle items. Agent handles and product names remain verbatim inside the placeholders.

placeholders.position: Selects pair for two names, middle for intermediate joins, and other for the final join in a longer list.
placeholders.head: The first agent name or the accumulated list; preserve verbatim.
placeholders.tail: The next agent name; preserve verbatim.
